card.name: Inside vasculitis disease names like GPA
card.fires_on: Words and symbols inside or just before names of vasculitis-type diseases, such as granulomatosis with polyangiitis (GPA), MPA and anti-GBM disease. It fires on the small linking pieces like 'with', '(', '/' and 'of' that come right before the next part of the name.
